Market Position & Performance Trends

Peddi continues to generate measurable theatrical activity across tracked markets, supported by admissions, occupancy movement and live gross collections recorded throughout the day.

Current performance trends suggest that the film's strongest markets continue contributing the majority of nationwide collections, while secondary territories remain important drivers of overall theatrical reach.

As additional shows report throughout the day, shifts in market share, admissions and occupancy levels may influence the film's overall box office standing.

State-Wise Contribution Analysis

Andhra Pradesh currently leads all tracked territories for Peddi, contributing approximately ₹5.12CR in tracked box office collections.

Telangana and Karnataka continue to rank among the strongest supporting markets, helping expand the film's admissions beyond its primary demand centre.

The current territorial distribution suggests that audience interest remains strongest in regions where the film already enjoys established awareness and franchise strength.

Top Cities Driving Collections

Hyderabad has emerged as the largest box office centre in BFILMY tracking and currently contributes the highest share of tracked admissions.

Vizag (Visakhapatnam) and Bengaluru also continue to record healthy ticket sales, reinforcing their position among the film's most important urban markets.

Performance in these cities continues to play a significant role in shaping nationwide collections and overall theatrical performance across tracked markets.

Exhibition Footprint & Theatre Reach

The film currently has a theatrical footprint spanning 971 tracked venues, reflecting support from both national multiplex operators and regional exhibition networks.

Justickets presently accounts for the largest volume of tracked admissions, while other major chains continue contributing to overall box office activity.

The breadth of exhibition coverage suggests that the release is positioned to attract audiences across multiple markets rather than relying on a limited concentration of locations.

Occupancy & Audience Behaviour

Average occupancy currently stands at 28.77%.

Audience demand remains visible across major markets, although occupancy levels indicate that attendance is becoming increasingly concentrated within the film's strongest performing territories.

The average ticket price currently stands at approximately ₹235, reflecting the combined influence of market mix, premium formats, regional pricing structures and exhibitor composition.

Box Office Outlook

Peddi continues to generate measurable theatrical activity across its tracked exhibition network, supported by admissions, occupancy movement and gross collections recorded throughout the day.

The strongest contribution currently originates from the film's leading markets, while secondary territories continue influencing nationwide performance through sustained audience participation.

As the theatrical run progresses, shifts in occupancy, admissions and territorial contribution will provide deeper insight into the film's overall box office trajectory and market sustainability.
